---
title: "Next and Recommendation"
author: "Yun Jiang"
---

## next

1. H: regenerate the S34_1 pileups of the current sample and compare the
   variant calls before and after the quality fix — the `all` pileup keeps
   65 % of its alt reads.
2. M: release the two pileup fixes and the dense-array port as the next
   version (plan/report pair as for 0.9.0).
3. M: trim the record loop of the pileup port by an estimated 10 to 15 % —
   read the flag once, keep the reference names in a list, add a fast path
   for reads whose bases all pass; 43 min alone against 31 min for the
   prototype.
4. M: ecsngsqc migration to sam-tagger must target 0.8.0: drop the
   `amplification_primer_*_seq` columns from the generated config (rename to
   `amp_primer_*` in the same change) and pass `--fasta` to the AP rules (S31
   annotate + any qc-summary call).
5. M: wps_1012 adopts v0.8.x (env pin): add error-stats `--fasta` and AP-rule
   `--fasta`, migrate qc-summary `_pct` column reads to `_rate`, and switch the
   S37_1 explicit-flags workaround to `--prefix`.
6. M: pin the suite invocation to the dev env (or add pytest to the default
   env) — bare `pixi run test` resolves pytest from the global pixi bin and
   fails at collection.
7. M: decide whether supplementary (0x800) records count in read-level
   metrics (total_reads/FL/on_target/AP); base-level metrics keep them.

## recommendation

1. H: ecsngsqc: drop or repair the 27 misplaced R1 records (fwd, POS 1,
   NM>=20, AS~len — e.g. at S23) — they manufacture the N-heavy error
   profile reported as mismatches.
2. M: report the bwa-mem2 placement defect upstream with the local repro
   recipe (fwd read, true window at ref pos 2-4 -> POS 1 + wrong MD/NM +
   kept AS; scripts in /tmp/samtagger_debug/).
3. M: add per-reference process parallelism and per-reference output writing
   to the pileup (investigation estimates: ÷5 to 6 on 6 cores; 4.3 GB now).
4. M: add a `to_n` column (or N split) to error.parquet so pairloom-
   unresolved N calls stay separable from true substitutions.
5. M: submit sam-tagger to bioconda with the next release —
   `recipes/sam-tagger/meta.yaml` is sha256-ready; use the conda-recipes
   `upload-to-bioconda` skill.
6. L: ecsngsqc: compute the S34_1 pileup once — the second run now costs
   43 min for a 0.03 % difference in the records.
7. L: on future releases, expect the release workflow to auto-create the
   GitHub release on tag push — use `gh release edit` for curated notes
   instead of `create`.
8. L: run `ruff format` on changed files only — the repo is not format-clean
   under the current ruff, and blanket runs rewrite unrelated files.
